## Semantic-audit verdict

**Verdict.** The frozen Lean package and the author handoff are equivalent for the modeled claim. The primary root quantifies a modeled four-arc candidate, assumes \(1<\lambda\) and the formal CMV type-\(\mathrm{iv}\) predicate, and negates the model’s universal equal-weighted-area, weighted-perimeter-minimality predicate. It does not normalize every source-defined CMV candidate and does not identify the source reduced-boundary perimeter with the model’s complete-frontier perimeter. [@lean:CMVSuffixModel.FourArcCandidate.not_isWeightedPerimeterMinimizer_of_density_gt_one]

### Scope and evidence

The inventory and handoff have the same \(464\) declaration names, each occurring once; every inventory entry is non-generated, and no generated family is configured. The SHA-256 values of all \(11\) inventoried Lean source files match the frozen inventory. The reviewed source contains no `sorry`, `admit`, or declared axiom. Each ledger statement was compared with its exact frozen declaration, including its hypotheses, quantifier structure, domains, endpoints, and conclusion.

### Model and geometry fidelity

The model uses the strip density equal to \(1\) on \(\lvert y\rvert\leq1\) and \(\lambda\) outside. It defines weighted area on the coordinate carrier and weighted perimeter against one-dimensional Hausdorff measure on the complete Euclidean frontier transported to that carrier. A four-arc candidate records \(0<h\leq1\) and \(0<\alpha<\pi/2\); the CMV predicate separately adds \(1<\lambda\) and \(\lambda\cos\alpha=h\). Minimality ranges over all admissible equal-area competitors. [@lean:StripDensity] [@lean:FrontierMeasure] [@lean:FourArcCandidate] [@lean:FourArcCandidate.SatisfiesCMVTypeIVHypotheses] [@lean:FourArcCandidate.IsWeightedPerimeterMinimizer]

The type-\(\mathrm{iii}\) assembly is an actual carrier with the major, semicircular, and minor cap branches, including the degenerate bottom segment at \(h=1/2\). Its carrier-area and complete-frontier-perimeter definitions are distinct, and its separate integrability theorems establish the corresponding area and frontier obligations. [@lean:TypeThreeAssembly.branch_complete] [@lean:TypeThreeAssembly.WeightedArea] [@lean:TypeThreeAssembly.WeightedPerimeter] [@lean:TypeThreeAssembly.integrableOn_carrier] [@lean:TypeThreeAssembly.integrable_frontierMeasure]

### Certificate coverage

The source establishes a stationary type-\(\mathrm{iv}\) fold in \((9/10,1)\), constructs a stationary equal-area type-\(\mathrm{iii}\) pair with strict perimeter improvement, and transfers that improvement through the descending equal-area envelope to every modeled \(0<h\leq1\), including \(h=1\). The geometric bridge turns each scalar witness into an admissible type-\(\mathrm{iii}\) competitor and thereby refutes modeled minimality. [@lean:LeanSuffixAnalytic.typeFourFold_zero_exists] [@lean:LeanSuffixAnalytic.stationaryEqualAreaPair_strictImprovement_exists] [@lean:LeanSuffixAnalytic.allCurvature_typeThreeImprovement_of_envelope] [@lean:CMVSuffixModel.FourArcCandidate.not_isWeightedPerimeterMinimizer_of_analytic_typeThree]

The Cañete--Miranda Jr.--Vittone citation resolves to arXiv:0906.1256; its cited §3.2, Lemma 3.8, Conjecture 3.12, and equations \((26)\)--\((27)\) are the stated strip-density and candidate-classification context. The supplied Lean \(4\) and mathlib DOIs resolve to the cited publications. No external citation lacks a stable locator.

### Disposition

Accept the package as an exact proof of the frozen modeled claim. The result remains conditional only in the stated modeling sense: source-level normalization and reduced-boundary compatibility are not proved or claimed.
